# Smarter Space Domain Awareness

Ecosmic is on a mission to reduce threat exposure in space. Enrich your understanding of where your assets are, and gain visibility on risks with in-depth, real-time assessments.

[Talk to an expert](https://calendly.com/imane-marouf-ecosmic/book-a-chat-with-imane) [Explore now](https://www.ecosmic.space/safe)

## Introducing SAFE

An advanced risk estimation and collision avoidance software designed to enhance space navigation and streamline operations. Using innovative algorithms and real-time data, it minimises false alerts, improves accuracy, and integrates effortlessly into your existing workflow.

[explore SAFE](https://www.ecosmic.space/safe) [Try SAFE for free](https://calendly.com/imane-marouf-ecosmic/ecosmic-let-s-talk-about-how-to-protect-your-assets)

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/684f91e952ffb1c731a90830/6852644e33fc11d1599a54d7_icon-optimized.svg)

### Optimized

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/684f91e952ffb1c731a90830/685261c5c46cf117a1a9227a_img-card-dots-white.webp)

### Optimized

Automates processes and improves prediction accuracy, removing 70% of false alerts and saving operators up to 20 hours per week.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/684f91e952ffb1c731a90830/6852644e820f97f798bafa1a_icon-reliable.svg)

### Reliable

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/684f91e952ffb1c731a90830/685261c5c46cf117a1a9227a_img-card-dots-white.webp)

### Reliable

Tested, certified, and trusted by industry leaders, supporting 52 satellites and improving 1500+ CDMs.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/684f91e952ffb1c731a90830/6852644ea30bb8b7cb533471_icon-effortless.svg)

### Effortless

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/684f91e952ffb1c731a90830/685261c5c46cf117a1a9227a_img-card-dots-white.webp)

### Effortless

Cloud-native, API-based, and available to be tested for free.
